description: Session-start context for eMemory. Command hooks only: they print this plugin's CLAUDE.md and a reminder, and the agent calls whichever eMemory server is configured.

hooks.command: echo 'eMemory: before starting work, run e_gather(action="intersect", match=["directive"]) for standing rules, e_property(action="list") for the property vocabulary, and e_gather(action="intersect", match=["session:current"]) for prior session context. If eMemory tools fail, invoke e-doctor.'
echo 'Session resumed: run e_gather(action="intersect", match=["session:current"]) and e_timeline(action="list", order_by="ingest_time_desc") to restore working context from eMemory.'

echo 'Context was compacted: run e_gather(action="intersect", match=["session:current"]) and e_timeline(action="list", order_by="ingest_time_desc") to restore the decisions, findings and state you stored in eMemory earlier this session.'
